(B) Supply a different/correct primers_A stock, if the one in B2:A2 is suspect, and then repeat as in (A).
(C) ABORT the experiment here and I file a failing report.

Also, please confirm two things I could not verify: (1) which gel lane the 750 bp band came from (was it the B2:B1 frag_A lane?), and (2) the measured concentrations of B2:B1, B2:B2, B2:B3.
